desc:
🐾 BE A PET!
Why ride a pet when you can BECOME the pet?
🥚 Hatch eggs and unlock tons of pets
🐶 Transform into every pet you collect
👥 Let your friends ride on your back
🌎 Explore a huge open world with different biomes
🌦️ Experience changing weather that can affect your adventure
✨ Discover rare mutations and special pet variants
💰 Earn cash, upgrade, and unlock even better pets
⚡ Become faster, stronger, and more valuable as you progress
🔓 Discover new areas, eggs, secrets, and rare creatures  
Explore the world, survive the weather, collect rare mutations, and become the ultimate pet.
👍 LIKE + FAVORITE for more pets, worlds, weather, and updates!
